note: Vehicle deployment volumes (WDSpawnVolume), deployment boards and infantry spawn managers placed in the world levels, grouped by the data layer of their streaming cell. A match enables one base-map data layer plus three spawn layers (one per team slot); see 'experiences'. Generated by _tools/vehicle_spawns.py.

Air: any air vehicle (every helicopter and the airplane, minus anything the volume excludes)
Land.Tracked: any tracked vehicle (minus the excluded faction APCs)

tag_display_names_basis: inferred from the internal-name rows of the vehicle articles; Havoc, Littlebird, ROT_01 and ROT_04 pairings follow the explosion and spotting tables

board_native_defaults.note: Fields the board Blueprint and the map boards leave unset keep these constructor values. The Blueprint overrides PlayerDeployCooldown (600 s) and RadarRestoreHealthThreshold (0.55); only the Gym test boards override the respawn timer (240 s) and the deploy cooldown (120 s). The consumers of the respawn timers were not located, so what exactly the game does with them is inferred from the field names.

fields.unit: speed units (not shown to be km/h)

board_timer_note: Map boards carry no instance overrides, so the blueprint default applies for PlayerDeployCooldown (600 s). VehicleRespawnTimer (300 s), LosingVehicleRespawnTimer (60 s), VehicleHealthThreshold (0.3) and VehicleSpeedThreshold (10) are not set in the blueprint or in any map instance, so the native class defaults read in round 53 apply; only the Gym test area overrides them (240 s respawn, 120 s deploy cooldown).
